capabilities.secureContextBabyMicHint: Open this site over HTTPS (or localhost) to use the baby unit microphone and WebRTC. Pairing and settings still work on this connection.
capabilities.webVersusNativeHint: You are in the web app. For background monitoring, system alarms, and kiosk options, use the GuardedSleep Android build. The browser version works for pairing and live sessions over HTTPS.

signaling.useDefaultTitle: Clear saved URL and use build-time default
signaling.validationProtocol: Only ws:// or wss:// is allowed

settings.title: Settings
settings.generalIntro: Defaults that apply when you start the app without a full invitation link. Pairing QR codes still carry their own connection details.
settings.signalingHelp: Advanced: default WebSocket for discovery. Invites from QR always use the server embedded in the invite.
settings.childIntro1: These values apply on this device when it runs as the baby unit. They are stored locally and picked up when monitoring starts.
settings.childIntro2: From a connected parent, use "Open settings on baby device" to jump this unit here (same trust as listen controls).
settings.parentIntro: Listen, snooze, link quality, and notifications are on the Parent unit screen during a session.
settings.notificationsIntro: How alerts sound on this parent device. Run a probe test after pairing when both units are connected.
settings.wakeLockListenLabel: Keep screen on in listen mode
settings.batteryIntro: Exempt GuardedSleep from aggressive battery optimization so monitoring can continue in the background.
settings.batteryWebHint: Battery exemption is configured in the Android system settings of the device.
settings.aboutIntro: GuardedSleep is a software baby monitor — it cannot alert if your parent unit is off or out of battery.
settings.advancedWarning: Advanced settings can break monitoring if changed without care. Defaults work for most homes and events.
settings.diagnosticsPlaceholder: Diagnostics export and security fingerprint — coming in a later release.

listenButton.hint: Hold to listen, slide up to lock

onboarding.title: Welcome to GuardedSleep
onboarding.welcomeLead: A few quick steps so you know when monitoring is active — and when it is not.
onboarding.failureModelBody: Like every baby monitor, GuardedSleep cannot alert if your parent unit dies. Keep it plugged in or charged when monitoring.
onboarding.trainingIntro: Watch the bar switch between connected and not monitoring. When the green indicator is gone, you are not receiving updates.
onboarding.trainingConnectedCopy: Connected — you are monitoring this room.
onboarding.trainingDisconnectedCopy: Not monitoring — you would not get noise alerts right now.
onboarding.batteryBody: On Android, allow GuardedSleep to run in the background and disable battery restrictions for reliable monitoring.
onboarding.batteryOpenFailed: Could not open battery settings. Try again or open them manually in Android system settings.
onboarding.doneLead: You are ready to pair the baby and parent units.
onboarding.probeHint: After pairing, tap Test alert on the parent screen before you leave earshot.

babySound.holdTitle: How long noise must stay loud
babySound.holdHelp: Ignores brief sounds. Longer waits mean fewer alerts, but slower reaction.

safety.body: Keep this unit on the charger, on a stable surface, out of your child's reach. Don't use a device with a swollen or damaged battery.

dndBypass.title: Alerts during Do Not Disturb

limits.body: GuardedSleep can only alert you while this unit is on and charged. Keep it plugged in at night. If both units turn off, nobody is alerted.
